attr.title: CryMon
attr.desc: Max walks out of the cottage with Quillpup and no Capture Crystals. Anne presses five into her hand after the first fight. Tall grass hides wild CryMon. Tamers will not. Native 640x480 PortMaster port of Max's Run.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Unzip into the existing ports folder (CryMon.sh and the crymon folder only), or drop this zip in PortMaster autoinstall. Do not replace the ports folder. Needs SDL2 (already on the device). A/B/Start on the pad, or a keyboard.
